meta.target_audience: Personal & Family Traveler (Lightweight, Personal Scale, Non-Enterprise)
meta.dietary_default: 100% Pure Vegetarian / Sattvik (App default, no redundant labelling needed)

stack.typography: Google Sans Flex (Used exclusively across all components)
stack.icons: Minimal Flat SVG Line Icons (No emojis allowed)
stack.theme: Dark Glass System (Sapphire Blue #38BDF8 & Radiant Violet #8B5CF6 on #070913 background)
stack.offline_capabilities: Service Worker (Cache-first network fallback, offline PWA installation)

integrations.weather_api: Open-Meteo Live API (Fetch current temp, wind speed, WMO weather codes & 7-day mountain rain forecast)
integrations.maps: Leaflet.js (Dark CartoDB tiles, elevation markers, distance calculation & Google Maps direct navigation links)

header.brand: Clickable UK Uttarakhand Logo (Takes user to Home/Itinerary tab and scrolls to top)
header.reset_action: Icon-only reset button (Clears location checkmarks only, preserves expenses and notes)

tab_1_itinerary.countdown_banner: Flight arrival status banner with one-tap cab driver call (+91 90272 44461)
tab_1_itinerary.weather_widget_strip: Interactive city weather cards (Dehradun, Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar) opening 7-day forecast modal
tab_1_itinerary.date_filter_strip: Horizontal day selector (ALL TRIP, SEP 4 - SEP 9)
tab_1_itinerary.category_filter_bar: Pill filters (All Stops, Skipped Stops, Hotel Stays, Food & Dining, Holy Shrines, Adventure, Nature, Sightseeing)

bento_grid_layout.tier_1_hero: Current Scheduled Stop (Auto-progressed based on real-time date/time, displays distance, est. drive, weather, highlights, food recommendations, and maps navigation)
bento_grid_layout.tier_2_next: Next Immediate Stop (Medium horizontal card showing distance away and category tag)
bento_grid_layout.tier_3_upcoming: Upcoming stops rendered in a 2-column bento grid separated by visual Day Divider Headers (e.g. DAY 1: SEP 4 • DEHRADUN TO MUSSOORIE)

tab_1_itinerary.night_rest_cards: Explicit Hotel Stay & Night Rest cards at the end of each day highlighting confirmed hotel bookings

tab_2_live_map.interactive_map: Leaflet map with route polyline connecting all 35 locations
tab_2_live_map.gps_integration: Device GPS location detection and live sorting of nearby spots by distance
tab_2_live_map.mountain_altitude_profile: Visual elevation bar chart showing altitude progression from Dehradun (430m) up to Surkanda Devi (2,757m Peak)

tab_3_essentials.hotel_reservations: Confirmed booking cards with reservation IDs, dates, advance paid, and total cost
tab_3_essentials.culinary_guide: Regional food recommendations for Landour cafes, Rishikesh riverside dining, and Haridwar street food
tab_3_essentials.categorized_packing_checklist: Expandable checklist across 4 categories: Medicines & First Aid (headache, vomiting, altitude), Clothing & Wearables, Electronics & Gear, Hygiene Supplies
tab_3_essentials.emergency_helplines: Disaster management (1070), police (112), ambulance (108), cab support

tab_4_toolkit_expenses.metric_cards: Interactive clickable cards for Total Cost, Advance Paid, and Pending Due that open breakdown modals
tab_4_toolkit_expenses.expense_management: Centered 'Add Expense' popup modal + inline pencil edit and trash delete controls for each expense item
tab_4_toolkit_expenses.sorting: Expense breakdown grid sorted in descending order (latest expenses first)
tab_4_toolkit_expenses.driver_support: Dedicated cab driver direct call card (+91 90272 44461)

location_details_modal.trigger: Tapping any location bento card opens a bottom sheet modal

instructions_for_ai_assistant.role: You are acting as an expert AI Personal Travel Assistant & Product Advisor.
instructions_for_ai_assistant.task: Review the above technical specifications, UI design, and feature set of this personal travel PWA. Provide smart, actionable recommendations to improve the app and suggest innovative new features.
constraints: Keep recommendations tailored for a personal / family travel app (NOT an enterprise or multi-tenant commercial SaaS).
Focus on lightweight, high-value personal utility that makes a 6-day road trip smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
Respect the offline-first, single-file HTML/JS PWA architecture.

requested_output_format.1_app_strengths_summary: Brief analysis of what makes this current setup strong for personal travel.
requested_output_format.2_ux_ui_refinements: 3 to 4 practical UI/UX tweaks to make on-the-go usage even smoother while riding in a cab or walking in mountain terrain.
requested_output_format.3_smart_feature_suggestions: 4 to 5 high-impact personal travel assistant features (e.g. Quick Offline Audio / Sight Info snippets, Family Photo Spot Logger, Offline Trip Expense Splitter, Daily Morning Pack Reminder, Sunset Alert Notifier).
requested_output_format.4_technical_optimization_tips: 2 to 3 lightweight technical performance or PWA enhancements.
